messages:
Elaine: Quick update — Medicore Health's integration just went GA on Redwood Marketplace and their Private deployment is live in us-east-1. Contract signed: 3yr, reserved Dedicated + Private, ~ $1.15M ARR. Big win for regulated healthcare ISVs! :tada:
Sam: Congrats team! Who's own the case study + exec quote?
Ravi: I'll own the case study. Plan: 1) 2-week timeline for customer interview 2) collect metrics (latency, cost savings vs their old infra) 3) quote from CTO. Need legal sign-off on PHI language.
Miguel: I can review DPIA and PHI clauses — ping me the redline by EOD.
Clare: Marketing happy to draft a launch blog + 1 pager. Can we get a few screenshots of the Console and a short architecture diagram? Also need customer logo permission.
Elaine: @Clare will coordinate with @Ravi for screenshots. @Sam please loop in contact for logo + quote.
Sam: Doing it now — intro sent to Medicore's Head of Product.
DeployBot: Deployment success: private-deploy/medicore-health — completed in 2026-03-18 19:42 UTC — no failures.
Ravi: Early perf numbers from QA: p50 gen latency 330ms, token cost down 42% after batching/quantization tweaks.
Elaine: Nice. Also flagged for a short exec sync next Wed 10am PT to brief SVP Sales & Head of Product on upsell opportunities.
Clare: Drafting blog outline, sending to Elaine & Ravi for review tomorrow.
Sam: FYI — this pushes us into top-10 healthcare ISV pipeline for Q2.
Elaine: Huge thanks to eng-runtime and sales ops for the tight turnaround. :heart:
Miguel: Legal will follow up with a quick data-processing appendix.
Ravi: I'll set up the interview slot with Medicore's CTO. ETA: by Mar 25th.
Elaine: Closing notes: please add anything else to this thread. We want a polished case study in 3 weeks. :rocket:
